title: adding movement to tracks by automating distortion on master channel
text:
here i'm automating the dry/wet level of a saturation/distortion plugin that's on the master to add some movement across every 4 bars. in bitwig 4 i can draw curves with the native `steps` modulator, triggered every 8th note, to do this. v5 has new MSEG features that do this even better, but for now (aka just the next few weeks, hopefully...) i'm still only on v4.10

plugin i'm using is density, i have another short video on cranking it up all the way with a low dry/wet in parallel (which is basically what we are doing here): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D4YLFTE_5co

other ways to do this (for any DAW): 
- LFOs that sync to the beat
- copy + paste automation
- third party plugins like shaperbox

these can work to the same effect but for me using stock envelopes feels more elegant

edit: now that bitwig 5 is out we can use the new Curves modulator to do this. this method still works for those on Essentials or Producer edition which don't yet have access to Curves
